rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who made the quiche, cake and dip? Our party menu has three missing names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You keep asking about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've also thanked two people for one quiche. Let's get all three right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know the cake maker. For the others, we'd have to ring everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ring everyone. I'll rewrite the menu with every cook credited. Ask about all the dishes; even the labeled ones need checking.

card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.
